# PallmLaw

> PallmLaw is workflow and firm-intelligence software for trusts and estates law firms. It helps firms control Estate Planning, Probate, and Trust Administration matters, automate workflows and client communication, identify stalled work, and measure operational performance.

Canonical website: https://pallmlaw.com
Former name: LawOps
Owner and operator: Pallm Tech LLC
Commercial focus: Estate Planning, Probate, and Trust Administration law firms in the United States

- [Trust Administration Workflow](https://pallmlaw.com/trust-administration-workflow-software): Trust Administration workflow control for law firms
- [Workflow Automation](https://pallmlaw.com/workflow-automation): Matter-stage, task, deadline, wait, and handoff automation
- [Client Communication](https://pallmlaw.com/client-communication-automation): Firm-controlled, workflow-triggered client communication

## Current shipped capabilities

- Matter records connecting workflow, parties, tasks, notes, stages, critical dates, ownership, communication history, and activity
- Configurable Estate Planning, Probate, Probate Release, and Trust Administration workflows
- Critical-date operations connected across matters, calendars, reporting, workflows, and automation
- Matter-level automation visibility and an administrative Automation Monitor
- Firm-branded communication templates, workflow email actions, delivery records, and relevant matter communication history
- Firm Intelligence for retained rate, cycle time, stalled matters, workload, and team context
- Governed read-only REST API and MCP access with scopes, rate controls, and audit history
- Dedicated application infrastructure and a dedicated PostgreSQL database for each firm

## Product boundaries

- PallmLaw is not positioned as a generic AI product or a replacement for every legal system.
- AI access is governed, read-only, scoped, audited, and user-attributed.
- Estate Planning, Probate, and Trust Administration are active commercial segments.
- Workflow revision controls described as v1.6 are beta or release-candidate capabilities until production acceptance is recorded.
- Product claims should be taken from the canonical PallmLaw pages above.
